required_for_each_module: actual extracted relative path and SHA-256
load address plus loader trace or crt0 evidence
entry address plus control-flow or runtime transfer evidence
module size, overlay lifetime, other resident dependencies
cache-through mapping and any code mutation/SMC evidence
trace/log/disassembly filenames and line or offset references
do_not_treat_as_proof: the load address declared in IP.BIN alone
toolchain self-tests or a synthetic demo
